report.question: 稳定性的二阶面积约束为何在余维一迫使平坦，而在高余维导向全纯性；复法丛、覆盖和各向同性曲率又怎样把这一机制转化为大小与拓扑限制？
report.reading_scope: Entire official SIAM mathematical body §§1-4 plus the complete versioned Fraser-Schoen 2303.07423v1 TeX §§1-5. Selected branches are integrated with worked calculations and precise external inputs; the full research proofs are not reconstructed.

proof_scope.2L01: Defines the pullback normal bundle and projected connection; derives the Weingarten pairing by differentiating orthogonality. Explicitly distinguishes vector B=-A nu and Hvector=-H nu from the site's scalar convention.
proof_scope.2L02: Derives the arbitrary-codimension real second variation from a normal geodesic variation and the determinant derivative. Defines stability and real Morse index for internally compactly supported normal variations; no free-boundary formula.
proof_scope.2L03: Calculates the complex-bilinear and first-variable-linear Hermitian extensions; proves the isotropic dimension bound and relates the null relation to conformality.
proof_scope.2L04: Koszul-Malgrange local existence is cited. In complex dimension one the integrability obstruction vanishes; metric compatibility explicitly proves holomorphic self-duality.
proof_scope.2L05: Euclidean complex second variation is derived in full from the real formula and integration by parts. The curved Micallef-Moore formula is cited, not claimed proved. Its curvature term is b(R(s,u_z)u_barz,bar s); the unit-sphere check gives lambda^2 |s|^2/2 and the negative sign in Q.
proof_scope.2L06: Defines general calibration and proves the compact homologous-chain volume comparison by Stokes, with multiplicities and compactly supported variations stated.
proof_scope.2L07: Computes comass, closedness and equality planes of a constant orthogonal complex structure; proves calibration of J-holomorphic curves.
proof_scope.2L08: Computes the induced metric, proves completeness using Cauchy sequences, exhibits a nonzero normal second derivative, and calculates curvature and total absolute curvature 2 pi.
proof_scope.2L09: Defines finite-cover stability and proves it for calibrated immersions by pullback of the calibration, retaining parameter-domain multiplicities.
proof_scope.2L0A: Proves finite-cover stability for two-sided hypersurfaces by the fiberwise sum of squares, its smooth square-root regularization, Schwarz and dominated convergence. Neither completeness nor compactness is assumed.
proof_scope.2L0B: States the finite-total-curvature compactification and smooth Gauss-map/normal-bundle extension as Osserman-Micallef inputs. Does not claim extension of the singular induced surface metric.
proof_scope.2L0C: Given the cited bundle extension, explicitly computes logarithmic cutoff energy and proves convergence of all terms in the compactified stability inequality. Covers of the compactification retain finitely many punctures.
proof_scope.2L0D: Birkhoff-Grothendieck splitting and uniqueness are cited. The O(a) section calculation, global generation for a>=0, and at-least-half-rank consequence of self-duality are proved.
proof_scope.2L0E: States Micallef's complete oriented genus-zero finite-total-curvature stability theorem. The proof overview links proved cutoff and section calculations, but the fixed ambient complex-subspace construction remains cited.
proof_scope.2L0F: States the Arezzo-Micallef-Pirola genus-two counterexample in R^(2m), m>=11; neither its construction nor stability proof is reproduced.
proof_scope.2L0G: Constructs the unitary flat quotient and derives its section equivariance. Proves absence of nonzero holomorphic sections for nontrivial monodromy. Realization of every degree-zero holomorphic line bundle as unitary flat is cited; analytic degree is locally defined by meromorphic zeros and poles.
proof_scope.2L0H: Constructs explicit unit sections on degree-k^2 covers, verifies both period transformations, and derives the C_tau/k derivative estimate after reducing each phase modulo 2 pi.
proof_scope.2L0I: Computes all holomorphic sections of the rank-two unipotent quotient and proves nonsplitting. Atiyah's identification/classification is cited with indecomposability retained.
proof_scope.2L0J: States the complete oriented finite-total-curvature genus-one cover-stable theorem. Atiyah filtration, uniformly controlled estimates and the fixed ambient complex-subspace step are research inputs; the narrative is explicitly a proof overview.
proof_scope.2L0K: Proves a conditional coercivity lemma with uniform upper and lower Gram bounds and small derivatives on finite covers. Does not assert the existence of such frames for arbitrary degree-zero bundles or replace the original filtration proof.
proof_scope.2L0L: Defines normalized complex sectional/PIC curvature, verifies basis independence and expands the real four-frame formula with the factor 1/4. Uses the standard first Bianchi identity and checks the space-form normalization.
proof_scope.2L0M: Derives a strict instability criterion for a nonzero compactly supported isotropic complex normal section from the cited curved second-variation formula, with all conformal factors and the conversion to a real negative variation explicit.
proof_scope.2L0N: Works out RP^3 x S^1: PIC>=1/2 by projection and Bessel, stability of the product torus by shortest-loop length and the sliced index form, and a negative constant-normal direction on its double cover.
proof_scope.2L0O: States the unbranched immersion specialization of Fraser-Schoen's stable-torus systole bound with a universal constant. Does not import numerical constants from differing curvature conventions or reproduce the intrinsic-distance/normal-bundle estimates.
proof_scope.2L0P: States the Micallef-Moore area-index bound floor((n-2)/2) for minimal immersed two-spheres in PIC. The construction of a negative-definite subspace is cited, not inferred from independent individual negative vectors.
proof_scope.2L0Q: Proves closed two-sided Ricci-nonnegative rigidity with f=1; proves nonexistence under positive Ricci. Closedness and two-sidedness are essential to the test field.
proof_scope.2L0R: States the no-Z^2 subgroup theorem for closed PIC manifolds of dimension >=4, using the report and Fraser-Schoen formulation for the full dimension range. Minimal-map existence, branch handling and group-to-size arguments are not reconstructed.

remaining_branches: Full Micallef fixed-complex-subspace argument, Atiyah bundle classification, and Fraser-Schoen's quantitative filtration/metric estimates remain cited research inputs.
The complete curved complex second-variation derivation and Koszul-Malgrange local existence are cited, not reconstructed.
The high-genus counterexample construction and Micallef-Moore negative-subspace construction are not reproduced.
The systole theorem's full intrinsic-distance estimates, branched minimal-map existence and fundamental-group argument are not reconstructed.

Report §2 codimension-one developments reuse 2G rather than duplicate Jacobi/second-variation foundations. Stable Bernstein is recorded for complete two-sided hypersurfaces in ambient R^n, n<=6; the R^7 no-growth problem is open in the report, while graphical Bernstein has ambient n<=8.

The question of replacing genus-one cover stability by ordinary stability remains a report question. The stable PIC disk-radius conjecture 4.13 stays in the outline as a conjecture, not a new theorem.
Free-boundary stability, Ricci-flow classification, and other broader classification branches are not developed.

terminology.normal_signs: 2G03 uses scalar A=<nabla nu,tangent>, H=div nu; 2E01 and 2L01 use vector B=(nabla_X du(Y))^perp, Hvector=-H nu in codimension one.
terminology.complex_pairings: b is complex bilinear; h(v,w)=b(v,bar w) is first-variable linear throughout 2L. 2L0K links 2L03 rather than the differently normalized convention of 004N.
terminology.isotropic: 各向同性 refers to a complex symmetric-bilinear null condition, distinguished from contact/symplectic isotropy.
terminology.stability: 覆盖稳定 means stability on every finite cover; boundary tests here are internally compactly supported/fixed-boundary, not free-boundary.
terminology.systole: 最短不可缩闭路长度; measured in the induced metric, not diameter or an ambient geodesic representative.
terminology.degree: 紧 Riemann 曲面上的全纯线丛沿用亚纯截面的零极点次数定义; 0B60 is linked with this analytic extension stated locally.
terminology.rank: 秩二自由阿贝尔群, not 二阶自由阿贝尔群.
terminology.external_check: Site terminology reused; external Banana Space terminology check unavailable.

source_errata.resolution: For u_z=(u_x-i u_y)/2, use b(u_z,u_z)=(|u_x|^2-|u_y|^2-2i<u_x,u_y>)/4. The displayed source plus sign does not encode conformality. Reuse 0T0T.
With a Hermitian unit basis, 4 K_C=K13+K14+K23+K24-2 R1234 for R_abcd=<R(ea,eb)ed,ec>. 2L0L derives this instead of copying the source's K12 entry and missing normalization factor.

source_errata.location: SIAM §3.5.1, degree-zero F_r tensor L description
source_errata.resolution: The description requires indecomposability. General degree-zero bundles must first be decomposed; 2L0I explicitly retains the hypothesis.

With rho(1)=exp(i theta), rho(tau)=exp(i phi) and f(z+gamma)=rho(gamma)f(z), take f_k=exp(i(theta_k xi+phi_k eta)/k), reducing k theta and k phi separately modulo 2 pi. 2L0H verifies both periods rather than copying the source's swapped phase labels.

The smooth extension is of tangent/normal subbundles, fiber metrics and projection connections. It is not smooth extension of the complete induced surface metric. 2L0B uses an auxiliary smooth conformal metric.
Keep two-sidedness when using scalar stable-hypersurface conclusions. No theorem for arbitrary one-sided hypersurfaces is inferred; 2L0Q is explicitly closed and two-sided.

source_errata.status: unresolved numerical threshold in source proof
source_errata.resolution: Tensoring rank r degree d by the inverse of a degree-two line bundle has degree d-2r, not d-2. The displayed d>r+2 bound is not justified by that calculation for general rank. No numerical threshold from this lemma is imported.

Pointwise spanning plus individually small derivatives does not suffice without uniform conditioning or controlled filtration estimates. 2L0K is only a conditional lemma with explicit uniform Gram bounds; 2L0J retains the full technical estimates as cited inputs.
The nearby [23] marker appears to point to Fleming rather than Fraser. Cite the named Fraser result and Fraser-Schoen v1 Theorem 5.6, not the mismatched numeric marker.
The text's injective homomorphism from pi1(M) to G does not match the torus-to-M setup. That proof sentence is not imported.

source_errata.status: unresolved proof step, not a claimed disproof
source_errata.resolution: The use of proper discontinuity to obtain divergent shortest translation lengths needs more than divergence of displacement at one fixed basepoint. No independent repair of this step is claimed; 2L0R cites the research theorem.

Use a universal constant only, and state the unbranched immersed-torus specialization. Do not transfer numerical constants or dimension/orientability qualifications blindly between versions and curvature conventions.
